CURRENT TICKET
Ticket ID: TEST-017
Title:
Mixed German-English starter condition with nested logic and a voltage threshold.

Description:
StarterEnable is FALSE even though the observed operating point appears to satisfy the nested enable condition. Additional requirements cover low-voltage and service-mode behavior.

TEST INFORMATION
Test Steps:
1. Set Zündung / IgnitionState to ON.
2. Select GearPosition N.
3. Keep ServiceMode INACTIVE.
4. Verify StarterEnable is TRUE.

Reported Test Result:
StarterEnable remained FALSE at the verification point.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS

REQ-1701
Wenn IgnitionState = ON und (GearPosition = P oder GearPosition = N) and ServiceMode is not ACTIVE, StarterEnable shall be TRUE.

REQ-1702
If BatteryVoltage is below 9.5 V, StarterEnable shall be FALSE.

REQ-1703
Wenn ServiceMode = ACTIVE, StarterEnable shall remain FALSE.

None provided.

Not available.

BatteryVoltage remained 12.2 throughout the complete evaluated interval.
ServiceMode remained INACTIVE throughout the complete evaluated interval.
Snapshot ID: START_POINT
IgnitionState = ON
GearPosition = N
StarterEnable = FALSE

TASK
Interpret the supplied German/English requirement wording without simplifying away the nested AND/OR logic.
Do not treat an opposite point or unrelated requirement as a replacement for the requirement's own condition.
